segments.title: Station Sign-On & Cold Open
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as a dog; Case joins late citing business meetings; pregnancy hallucination banter ensues.

segments.title: Trump Executive Orders: Trans Athlete Ban & Gaza Ownership
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins Case at the desk to cover Trump's EO barring transgender athletes from women's sports (targeting ~10 NCAA athletes) and Trump's proposal for U.S. ownership of Gaza with permanent displacement of Palestinians; NCAA compliance, Marco Rubio's IOC pressure, and civil rights office realignment discussed.

segments.title: Movie Trailer Roundtable: Fantastic Four, Jurassic World, The Visitor 1979
segments.notes: Case, Chris, and Kendelle watch and dissect trailers for The Fantastic Four: First Steps, Jurassic World Rebirth, and the 1979 Italian film The Visitor; SCTV turkey-stuffing sketch airs.

segments.title: Crum's Monthly News: Google Gemini Gouda Error
segments.notes: Crum fulfills contractual monthly news obligation covering Google editing its Super Bowl ad to remove Gemini's false claim that Gouda constitutes 50–60% of global cheese consumption.

segments.title: Hype Train Derailment: Anti-Music Freestyle
segments.notes: Triggered by Uncle Phil 2K's bits; Hype Train abandons donor acknowledgments for a freestyle rap declaring music causes testicular cancer and demanding AI replace all music with Bitcoin.

segments.title: Dance Facials, Turkey Stuffing & Chinese New Year Apps
segments.notes: Jeb and his wood-trapped father present a STEEZY dance facial tutorial, an SCTV Cruisin' Gourmet turkey-stuffing sketch, and a CNET tech minute on Chinese New Year apps.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid
segments.notes: Case wraps, announces Friday return 12:30–1:30 PM, plugs Patreon for Cast content, and raids Gina.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors truncated broadcast; covers Trump EOs and Gaza proposal; pivots to trailers and Crum/Jeb segments; announces schedule changes and Friday return.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold open as a dog; fields pregnancy jokes; confirms Case's Hollywood producer status at sign-off.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Delivers hard news on Trump's trans athlete ban and Gaza ownership remarks; exits early citing bleakness.

characters.name: Chris
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Studio guest for trailer roundtable; debates Fantastic Four casting and Jurassic lore; confirms Kendall's viewing history.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Joins trailer discussion; picks Jurassic World Rebirth; chooses invisibility as preferred superpower; plugs Danny Plotz.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Appears for contracted monthly news segment on Google's AI cheese error; riffs on goat cheddar vs. Gouda.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: musical interruption. Derails hype train into anti-music freestyle; claims music causes testicular cancer; demands AI replace music with Bitcoin.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Hosts How To with dance facial tutorial, turkey stuffing sketch, and Chinese New Year app roundup; bickers with wood-trapped father.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: deceased co-host. Trapped in a single piece of wood; recalls death day for facial exercise; debates wood metaphysics with Jeb.

storylines.beat: [01:04:27] Crum fulfills contractual monthly news obligation with a Google AI cheese error segment, no mention of gorilla wager or groin punch.

lore_notes.fact: Case's new job pushes stream end later; Monday night streams and Call Cast revival (spring/summer) under consideration.
Crum is contractually obligated to deliver a monthly news segment.
Google edited its Super Bowl Gemini ad to remove the false statistic that Gouda makes up 50–60% of world cheese consumption.
Case will raid Gina (Miss Gina) and return Friday 12:30–1:30 PM for a longer broadcast.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a compressed broadcast covering Trump's executive order banning transgender athletes from women's sports and his proposal for U.S. ownership of Gaza, then pivots to a movie trailer roundtable with Chris and Kendelle. Crum fulfills a contractual monthly news segment on Google's AI cheese hallucination, Hype Train derails into an anti-music freestyle, and Jeb Nogget delivers a How To on dance facials and turkey stuffing before Case signs off to raid Gina.
